bibl.title: Political and Sacred Animals: Religious Associations in Greco-Roman Egypt.
bibl.seg: Andrew Monson, Political and Sacred Animals: Religious Associations in Greco-Roman Egypt.
Benedikt Eckhardt, Private associations and Jewish communities in the Hellenistic and Roman cities = Supplements to the Journal for the study of Judaism. 191 (Leiden, 2019) pp. 37-57.
bibl.note: Adopts a comparative perspective, using Egyptian religious associations, known primarily from Demotic texts, as a quasi-independant case study for comparing associational behavior, even if there are some signs in the textual and archaeological evidence that associations in Egypt were converging on a common Mediterranean pattern during the Greco-Roman period.
